name: input
title: Input
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova input, fixed: in dark, no fill, its border alone (3:1) outlining it, so it is not a grey slab on a card or a dialog. size="sm": 28px and 13px, beside a toolbar's or a composer's 28px buttons (36px on a phone, 16px text under 768px so iOS does not zoom); a number is still the native size. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md).
